name: Youth TRAIN in Trades (Richmond SD38)
what_you_do: Start Level 1 trades training at a college while still in high school. You earn high school and college credit. You are signed up as an apprentice with SkilledTradesBC.
who_can_apply: Students at Richmond SD38 schools. Sixteen trades are offered. Some are welding, wood building, electrical work, cooking, car repair, plumbing and hair styling.
pay_detail: School district pays tuition for the first level (the page says this often saves $2,500 to $5,000)
duration: One full program, taken in the 2027-28 school year for this intake
deadline_text: Applications for 2027-28 are open. Preferred deadline Feb 2, 2027. Second deadline Mar 2, 2027.
how_to_apply: Get the form from the district page. You can also ask your counsellor or career advisor. Or check your school Career Programs board.
